It may be old, but Team Fortress 2 is a game with true passion put behind it. The Characters and World always pull me back into the chaos of this fandom.

The artstyle is supreme, the soundtrack is amazing, and the gameplay still holds up extremely well, even after 18 years!

I will admit, the game isn't in the best state, mostly thanks to Valve's neglect. The game receives occasional updates, but they are mostly just community cosmetics and maps.

The last TRUE update was all the way back in 2017, so it has been a hot minute.

I really do love TF2, and still enjoy playing it, but I do wish Valve put more effort into keeping this game actually alive (and secure, especially secure.)
